attchmntText: Creative Newtech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Creative Newtech Limited enters into Strategic Brand License Agreement with AT&T Intellectual Property, LLC, USA, marking a Major Expansion into Technology Infrastructure Solutions Across India and International Markets'.
voiceSummary: Creative Newtech Limited entered into a Brand License Agreement with AT&T Intellectual Property, LLC, USA, on 12th November 2026. The agreement grants Creative Newtech the right to use AT&T trademarks for specified technology infrastructure products. Licensed categories include containment systems, copper systems, data centre solutions, fibre systems, outside plant systems, and structured cabling systems. The Company aims to expand its Brand Business portfolio into technology infrastructure solutions. The agreement covers designated domestic and international markets. These markets include India, Southeast Asian countries, the Middle East, Africa, New Zealand, and Australia. Product introduction and market expansion will occur in phases. The development is subject to the terms of the agreement and applicable approvals.

attchmntText: Submission of Newspaper Advertisement published in Pratah Kaal, Marathi Newspaper, Page No. 5 regarding Dispatch of EGM Notice and Details for the Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled on 28th November 2026
voiceSummary: Assets Care and Reconstruction Enterprises Limited issued a notice under Section 13 of the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002. The company has taken possession of properties from borrowers to recover dues. Notices were served on borrowers including Rahyul Jardishkumar Yad, Asmita Kumari Prajapati, Ramesh Ramprakash Mavji, and Mahesh Aphoday Choursiya. The properties are located in Mumbai and Thane. The total amount claimed is approximately Rs. 45 lakh plus interest and costs. Creative Newtech Limited announced an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for Saturday, 28th November 2026 at 11:00 A.M. The meeting will be held via video conferencing. Remote e-voting is open from Wednesday, 25th November 2026 at 9:00 A.M. to Friday, 27th November 2026 at 5:00 P.M. The cut-off date for voting eligibility is Saturday, 21st November 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Newspaper Advertisement published in Active Times, English Newspaper, Page No. 3 regarding Dispatch of EGM Notice and Details for the Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled on 28th November 2026
voiceSummary: Creative Newtech Limited will hold an Extraordinary General Meeting on 28th November 2026 at 11:00 A.M. via video conferencing. Remote e-voting opens on 25th November 2026 at 9:00 A.M. and closes on 27th November 2026 at 5:00 P.M. The cut-off date for voting eligibility is 21st November 2026. Fundviser Capital India Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 379.97 lakh for the quarter and 429.22 lakh for the half year. Consolidated net profit after tax was 319.00 lakh for the quarter and 624.23 lakh for the half year. The District Deputy Registrar, Co-operative Societies, Thane, issued a public notice regarding application number 877 of 2026 by Kapaleshwar Co-operative Housing Society Ltd. The hearing is scheduled for 23rd November 2026 at 1:30 P.M. regarding deemed conveyance for property in Ulhasnagar.
